question: Demonmail Hauberk has equip—sacrifice a creature. Can I sacrifice the creature it is already equipping in order to equip it to another creature?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: you can sacrifice the creature the Equipment is attached to as the cost to move it.
expected.answer: You can sacrifice the creature Demonmail Hauberk is equipping in order to equip it to another creature.

whyHard: Players assume that removing the equipped creature as a cost leaves nothing for the Equipment to attach from.
